responsibility: Implements terminal color and hyperlink policy for diagnostics. This file owns the GCC_COLORS capability table, parsing of user overrides, auto-detection of whether stderr supports color, parsing of GCC_URLS/TERM_URLS, and heuristics for enabling terminal hyperlink escape sequences, producing the SGR start/stop strings and URL format decisions consumed by pretty-printing and diagnostic emission.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the diagnostic-color pair: it defines the GCC_COLORS capability table and the environment/terminal probing logic that decides color and hyperlink behavior, whereas diagnostic-color.h only exposes the small policy enum and accessor/init declarations used by callers.
